concepts.gloss_en: The illumination/radiance of the hands (associated with dancing and clapping)
The revelation/manifestation OF the illumination of the hands — a distinct state (revelation) predicated on the illumination, not the illumination itself

members.note: representative; added construct head התגלות (revelation) makes this a state-about-X per rule 4, not identical to הארת הידים

notes: Same Torah (lm1:10), and הארת הידים does appear prefixed by התגלות in one of its own proof quotes, so the two are tightly related. But per rule 4, 'revelation of X' ≠ 'X' — the added head התגלות names a distinct concept (the act/state of revealing), so kept separate rather than merged.
